Class FilterRegistration

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.web.router.builder.FilterRegistration
@Internal public final class FilterRegistration extends Object
A filter declared on a route, a group or a server filter, see RouteFilterSpec, with the executor it runs on, which FilterSpec chooses after the filter was declared. The filter of the filter chain is created when the routes are built, once: the executor is fixed then, and a later change is ignored, like a change of a route the router took. The executor of a filter of a group cannot change once the lambda of the group returned.

5.3.0
